openai-codex/gpt-6-astra.character: Advisory: The advisor's own session model and the top-tier model for planning, implementation, review, and every kind of UX work. The advisor session runs at high; planner nodes, foremen, and substantial builds run at xhigh; fresh-context review, synthesis, adversarial checking on schema, auth, security, money, and data boundaries, and bounded implementation that still needs material local judgment run at high. All UX work, greenfield or existing, uses Astra with frontend-design loaded. Escalate to xhigh only for genuinely difficult debugging. Prefer Sol high, not Astra, when an execution packet has already locked the approach and material decisions.

openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol.character: Advisory: The procedural-tier workhorse at high reasoning for scouting, mechanical chores, routine mid-phase checks, repair verification, test-harness findings, browser verification, and implementation from a locked execution packet. The packet must fix the material approach, bound the surface, and name deterministic anchors. Sol owns ordinary local code choices but stops and escalates rather than deciding product, architecture, schema, migration, auth, fallback, destructive behavior, or external effects. Generally avoid adversarial-tier checking and decision-bearing implementation. Recommended reasoning is high.

cursor/grok-4.6.character: Advisory: High-efficiency generalist at high reasoning, kept as the alternate for research and bounded backend or mixed-stack work when Codex capacity is tight. UX work routes to Astra, not Grok. 200K window — keep packets bounded and split oversized work. Preserve Cursor catalog fast-mode default. This guide recommends Cursor only as cursor/grok-4.6.
